scope: Public source review during development. No external AI is integrated into the runtime; no personal ledger data was sent.

opus.finding: No P1/P2 identified within the supplied first-candidate diff. Source-only, no tools/browser/tests executed by reviewer. This is not blanket final approval.

tests/account-choice.test.cjs: actual frontend resolver with a legacy custom-name collision

browser_discovery.finding: A newly formalized account name could still resolve to an older alias on the frontend.
regressions: scripts/account_workflow_smoke.mjs: confirmed account change retains the newly chosen formal account

scope_after_opus: The independent custom-name/code correction followed the Opus diff review and was verified by targeted regressions, full256 Python tests and the final browser workflows. No additional blanket model approval is claimed.

surfaces: actual100 results and readonly account dialog
visual_review.limit: Local visual inspection and functional browser regressions, not a representative user study or complete accessibility certification.
